bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to vocational rehabilitation; appropriating money for the vocational rehabilitation services program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the vocational rehabilitation services program under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 268A. +]
